```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#load required packages:
```{r}
library("phyloseq")
library("tidyverse")
```

#load required data:
```{r}
ps16S_positive = read_rds("../../Analysis/Microbial Communities/Fungal-Bacterial Interactions/DeSeq2 Indicator Species Analysis/Results/ps16S_ASVs_RNA_positive_mip.rds")
```

# 
```{r}

# Melt relativized phyloseq object of positively-influenced 16S ASVs into a long dataframe
df <- psmelt(ps16S_positive)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Tree_label = paste0(Tree, ", ", core_bottom_depth_cm, " cm")
  )

# Get unique combinations of sample data and sort
sample_order <- df %>%
  select(Sample, Tree_Health, Tree, core_bottom_depth_cm) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Tree_Health, Tree, core_bottom_depth_cm) %>%
  pull(Sample)

# Relevel the Sample factor to reflect this order
df$Sample <- factor(df$Sample, levels = sample_order)

# Create label vector with names matching Sample IDs
sample_labels <- df %>%
  distinct(Sample, Tree_label) %>%
  deframe()  # converts two-column data frame to named vector


```


```{r}
text_size = 11
supfig6 = ggplot(df, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ Tree_Health, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = sample_labels) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("p__", "", x)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = text_size) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.title = element_text(size = text_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = text_size),
    strip.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    plot.title = element_text(size = text_size),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = text_size),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = text_size),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm")
  ) +
  ylab("Relative abundance") +
  xlab("Soil core") +
  labs(fill = "Phylum")

```


### export:
```{r}
# create the figure file in this results folder

# requirements: 1000 pp1 (pixels per inch), 140 mm wide
# 1 inch = 0.0393701 mm, 1 mm = 25.4 inches

ppi = 300

w_mm = 140
hw_ratio = 5/11 # arbitrary

h_mm = w_mm*hw_ratio
w_i = w_mm/25.4
h_i = h_mm/25.4

jpeg("Results/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund.jpg", width = w_i * ppi, height = h_i * ppi, res = ppi)
jpeg("../../Reports/Supplementary Material/Figures/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund.jpg", width = w_i * ppi, height = h_i * ppi, res = ppi)

supfig6
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# save as pdf

  ggsave(plot = supfig6, filename = ("Results/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = h_i, width = w_i, units = "in")

  ggsave(plot = supfig6, filename = ("../../Reports/Supplementary Material/Figures/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = h_i, width = w_i, units = "in")

```


# add margins
```{r}
supfig6_margins = ggdraw() + draw_plot(supfig6, 
                                       x = 0.05, # position figure to the right
                                       y = 0.05, # positition figure near the bottom
                                       width = 0.9,
                                       height = 0.9)
supfig6_margins
```

# add caption
```{r}
caption = ggdraw() +
  draw_label("Supplementary Figure 6. Relative abundance of 'ectomycorrhizal-promoted' ASVs within whole-sample bacterial communities 
as measured by 16S rRNA metabarcoding. 'Ectomycorrhizal-promoted' here refers to ASVs whose crude abundance in a soil sample was 
positivley correlated with the imputed biomass of ectomycorrhizal fungi. The y-axis represents the proportion (0-1) of the RNA-based 
bacterial community comprised by these ASVs within each discrete soil sample. On the X-axis, soil sample names denote both tree identity 
and soil depth in cm, and are clustered by tree identity. ASVs are colored according to their genus.", size = text_size, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)

supfig6_caption = plot_grid(caption, supfig6_margins,
                            ncol = 1,
                            rel_heights = c(0.2, 1))

supfig6_caption
```

# save figure
```{r}
# save as pdf

  ggsave(plot = supfig6_caption, filename = ("Results/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund_formatted.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = 8, width = 11, units = "in")

  ggsave(plot = supfig6_caption, filename = ("../../Reports/Supplementary Material/Figures/sup_fig_6_ecm_promoted_bac_relabund_formatted.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = 8, width = 11, units = "in")

```
